nodes.name: button_prod.json
nodes.summary: Drone flight course definition for a short 'button' production trajectory, specifying 3 timed keyframes of flat-output states (position, yaw, and derivatives) over about 4 seconds with no external force profile.
nodes.languageNotes: Each keyframe's 'fo' matrix holds per-derivative flat-output values (rows likely x, y, z/altitude, yaw; columns are derivative order), consistent with differentially-flat quadrotor trajectory generation; 'Nco' likely sets the polynomial/spline coefficient count used by the trajectory optimizer that consumes this file.

nodes.name: circuit.json
nodes.summary: Drone flight course definition for a 'circuit' loop trajectory, specifying 10 timed keyframes of flat-output states spanning roughly 12 seconds with no external force profile.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest of the four course files, with denser keyframing (sub-second spacing at points) to capture sharper turns along the circuit path.

nodes.name: infinity.json
nodes.summary: Drone flight course definition for a figure-eight ('infinity') trajectory, specifying 7 timed keyframes of flat-output states spanning roughly 12 seconds with no external force profile.
